senses.definition: n.pr.m. (= id. cf. אֵלָה n.pr.)
a son of Zebulun Gn 46:14 Nu 26:26.
אֵילֹן Gn 26:34; אֵילוֹן 36:2 a Hittite, father-in-law of Esau.
אֵילוֹן Ju 12:11, 12 a judge of Isr., of tribe of Zeb.
n.pr.loc. אֵילוֹן Jos 19:43 a town of Dan; so 1 K 4:9 (where read א׳ וּבֵית ח׳ Th Klo).
